title: [dev-e/f] Temp target cancellations from AAPSClient not reflected in AAPS phone
body:
I noticed recently that after installing dev-e, I can no longer cancel temp targets from AAPSClient phone. This persists in dev-f. 
I've tried waiting for next cycle to see if that helps, but the TT keeps on running until expired or cancelled from AAPS phone. 

Including logs from AAPSClient phone and AAPS phone, the relevant time is 00:28 for setting TT of 8mmol/l, and 00.30 for cancelling TT. 
[20230104 0028 AAPS log TT change received and cancel not received.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10340385/20230104.0028.AAPS.log.TT.change.received.and.cancel.not.received.txt)
[20230104 0028 AAPSClient log TT change and cancel.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10340386/20230104.0028.AAPSClient.log.TT.change.and.cancel.txt)

I tried reviewing the logs myself but not catching anything very obvious. 

AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-f
Build: 6e39ea1fbd-2022.12.30

comments.body: I noticed that as well. Same problem.
still persists in dev-f, build: 869ad7a42c-2023.01.10. Can set temp target from AAPSClient, but not cancel.
